extraction.provider_name: Girl Scouts Carolinas Peaks to Piedmont
extraction.notes: The official October 26, 2026 blog announces that 2027 Summer Camp details will be available November 19; it does not announce registration opening. No 2027 program list or dates were found. Official blog search results identify a 2026 Black Mountain day camp, but its venue, price and registration destination could not be found. Website and blog access was blocked by robots.txt; supplemental facts were read in official search results. The referenced 2026 Summer Camp Program Guide could not be retrieved. The summer page mentions troop camping at Camp Pisgah and Camp Ginger Cascades without identifying a supervised summer program or dates.

excluded.reason: The 2026 CIT program accompanies summer camp at Keyauwee Program Center in Sophia, outside the directory's drive area.

cards.review_notes: Black Mountain dates and rising grades were obtained from official dated blog search results. Find the drop-off venue and its published street address, price and registration link in the 2026 guide or registration platform. The 2027 details announcement applies to summer camp generally, not specifically a confirmed Black Mountain offering. The main page's three-meal and transportation FAQs concern overnight camp and were not applied to this card.
